title: 第25章 父皇不公父皇给他的爱孩儿从来未享受过第26章 重瞳之威震撼天地
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
“………………”
陆尘听到这话，却是一阵无语。
这个老家伙也是逃不过真香定律？
刚才还说就算是死。也不会同意自己和洛璃的。
结果现在变脸变的忒快，今天就订娃娃亲？
真够可以的。
“哈哈哈。今天太过夸张啊，后天吧，朕今天就通知下去，后天在皇宫大办御席，为小十一和小洛璃定下婚约！”
青帝看到洛振山真香的模样。也是忍不住哈哈大笑开口说道。
听到此言，洛振山却是笑着对青帝拱了拱手。
“既然如此，就依陛下所言，老臣这就回去把喜讯带回去，就先告退了。”
洛振山站了起来对着青帝拱手开口。
“行，去吧！”
看着洛振山离开，青帝笑眯眯的看着一旁的陆尘，却是越看越满意。
“小十一，这次来找父皇是有何事？”
“父皇，尘儿就是想你了。”
陆尘嘟着嘴开口。
“父皇总是忙得很，白天处理各种政事，晚上还有修炼，没有一点时间来陪父皇，尘儿想父皇，所以就来找父皇。”
“诶呦喂。我的宝贝儿小十一。”
青帝看着陆尘委屈巴巴的表情。再听到陆尘稚嫩的话，堂堂青帝的心都快化了。
直接一把把陆尘给抱了起来。

“尘儿啊，是朕的不对，以后你要是想父皇了直接找父皇，”
青帝捏了捏陆尘肉肉的小脸蛋开口说道。
“好的父皇。”
“不过父皇，你还记得前两天给儿臣的承诺嘛，答应尘儿一个条件。”
陆尘点了点头，随后便直接说出了自己这次来找青帝的主要目的。
“哦，当然记得，怎么，可是想好了条件？”
青帝听到此言，脸上露出了笑意，好奇的开口询问。
“父皇，尘儿要父皇今天给自己放次假，好好陪尘儿一天。咱们两个出宫在帝都逛逛，好好休息一天，”
陆尘水汪汪的眼睛盯着青帝，声音稚嫩的开口。
话音落下，青帝神色一怔。
反应过来，青帝却是情不自禁的抱紧了陆尘。
“好孩子，好孩子，这几年来，父皇让你受委屈了。”
“父皇，尘儿不委屈，只要父皇好好的，比什么都好。”
陆尘这一句话，宛若最后一把刀，狠狠的插在了青帝的胸口。
此刻，青帝的眼睛甚至有些发酸。
自己的一个承诺多宝贵？
然而，自己儿子，愿意为了让自己休息一天，为了陪自己一天，甚至愿意浪费自己的一个承诺。
青帝在回想起之前几年，自己对陆尘母子不管不顾。
自己真不是个人啊。
青帝内心狂吼。

“好，听尘儿的，今天咱们就出宫好好玩儿一天。”
青帝重重的拍了拍陆尘的肩膀开口。
半个时辰之后，换下龙袍，身着一身黑色锦衣的青帝和身着大红色小袄的陆尘两人走在皇宫之中，
content_en:
"………………"
Lu Chen was speechless when he heard this.
This old guy can't escape the law of true fragrance?
Just now I said it would be death. Nor would he agree with himself and Luo Li.
As a result, things have changed so quickly. Are you planning to get married today?
That's pretty good.
"Hahaha. Today is too exaggerated. The day after tomorrow, I will notify you today and hold a grand banquet in the palace the day after tomorrow to make an engagement for Xiao Shiyi and Xiao Luoli!"
Qing Emperor saw Luo Zhenshan's fragrant appearance. He couldn't help but laugh and said.
Hearing this, Luo Zhenshan smiled and bowed his hands to Qing Emperor.
"In this case, as your Majesty said, I will go back and bring the good news back, and then I will leave first."
Luo Zhenshan stood up and spoke to Qingdi.
"Okay, let's go!"
Watching Luo Zhenshan leave, Qingdi looked at Lu Chen beside him with a smile, but he became more and more satisfied with it.
"Xiao Shiyi, why did you come to see your father this time?"
"Father, Chen'er just misses you."
Lu Chen pouted and spoke.
"My father is always very busy. He deals with various political affairs during the day and practices at night. He doesn't have any time to accompany him. Chen'er missed his father, so he came to see him."
"Hey, hey. My precious little Eleven."
Qingdi looked at Lu Chen's aggrieved expression. Hearing Lu Chen's childish words again, the dignified Qing Emperor's heart almost melted.
He immediately picked up Lu Chen.
"Chen'er, it's my fault. If you miss your father in the future, go to him directly."
Qingdi pinched Lu Chen's fleshy little face and said.
"Okay, Father."
"But Father, do you still remember the promise you made to Chen'er two days ago? Promise Chen'er on one condition."
Lu Chen nodded, and then directly stated his main purpose of coming to Qingdi this time.
"Oh, of course I remember, why, but have you thought of the conditions?"
When Qingdi heard this, he smiled and asked curiously.
"Father, Chen'er wants father to give himself a day off today and spend a good day with Chen'er. The two of us will go out of the palace to walk around the imperial capital and have a good rest."
Lu Chen stared at Qingdi with watery eyes and spoke in a childish voice.
After the words fell, Qingdi looked startled.
After reacting, Qingdi couldn't help but hug Lu Chen tightly.
"Good boy, good boy, my father has made you suffer in the past few years."
"Father, Chen'er is not aggrieved. As long as father is good, that's better than anything else."
Lu Chen's words were like the last knife stabbed into Qingdi's chest.
At this moment, Qing Emperor's eyes even felt a little sore.
How valuable is your own promise?
However, his son was even willing to waste one of his promises just to give him a day off and to spend a day with him.
Qingdi recalled how he had ignored Lu Chen's mother and son in the past few years.
I am really not a person.
Qingdi roared in his heart.
"Okay, listen to Chen'er, let's go out of the palace and have a good day today."
Qingdi patted Lu Chen's shoulder heavily and spoke.
Half an hour later, Qing Di, who changed into his dragon robes and was dressed in black brocade clothes, and Lu Chen, who was wearing a big red coat, walked in the palace.
